standard_definition: 24 training rows, no flips; all methods, two dimensions, two seeds; per-candidate coefficient budget
stress_definition: All other 50 data conditions; all methods, D2048, first seed; per-candidate budget
ambiguity_definition: Four correlation-shift tasks, two plausible fields, 8 train+4 selection validation+4 risk calibration, 8 independent crossed-field tests. Add 8 new supervised training examples and refit. All methods, before/after, D512/2048, first seed. Both per-candidate and fixed-total numeric budgets.
selection: Train SS or symbolic class-mean memory on training rows only. Filter by absolute/relative training loss and train coverage, then tied best selection-validation loss within cap. Retain up to four minimum-cardinality masks. Overflow or unsupported family cannot confirm a result.
development_adjustment: Initial validation slack 0.0625 retained a demonstrably weak simple gap mask after two added development examples. Before final evaluation, set slack to 0; retains tied-best masks and allows the newly supported larger mask. No final evaluation result used for this adjustment.
hypothesis_scope: Separate phase memories with ordinary candidate IDs. Enumerate the Cartesian module-mask assignments up to four; if more exist, retain four contrasting representatives for diagnostics but veto confirmation even if they agree. ss_single is the explicit first-candidate ablation. No SS superposition of hypotheses or posterior-probability claim.
risk_gate: Strict complete-candidate unanimity, then empirical confidence gate fitted only on separate risk-calibration rows. Target 0.1 is empirical, not a statistical guarantee. Unsupported/overflow veto maintained.
equal_coverage: Report raw/calibrated counts and fixed threshold curves. Compare ss_multi, symbolic_multi, ss_single at equal accepted counts via deterministic gold-blind hash subsampling. Zero common coverage is undefined, never scored as a win. Also report all 5 methods, separately. These are descriptive test analyses, not runtime thresholds fitted on test labels.

language.full_standard: SS multi: 864 read, 432 direct generation, 864 reverse roundtrips
language.baselines: All four language methods on one representative per category/time/presentation combination (54 read and roundtrip requests)
language.ambiguity: Filter component, selection and temporal teacher corpora to positive/asserted or negative/hypothetical only. Add exactly two contrasting component pairs, no validation/test examples moved into training. Evaluate 36 direct generation requests before/after. Existing initial lexicon is supplied.

gates: All current language standard requests exact
SS multi ambiguity before abstains with no text; after added examples returns exact text
Synthetic ambiguity SS/symbolic multi at D2048 per-candidate: disagreement veto before, exact recovery after
Candidate-count bound, overflow veto, whole-meaning/whole-text agreement, packet contract and atomic abstention tests
Four-way split disjointness and metric accounting
Two full numerical runs reproducible without wall times/heap values
New unit tests, old releases tested separately, frozen source, archive integrity and isolated CLI verification
not_gates: Fixed numerical risk bound under correlation shift
No errors in every low-dimension/noisy condition
P1/S1 integration, third event, general natural language, all-SS learning
performance: Per-method timing and actual member/phase-block/cache/codec-array costs. Fixed-total experiment holds only numerical coefficient capacity, not headers or total RAM. Main-run timings may overlap the repeated run; optional standalone timing diagnostic is separate.
